annotations.title: TIA — cross-references of an object or a whole PLC

description: Cross-references of ONE object or of a whole PLC: for every source object, the objects that use it or that it uses, each with its locations (block, network, address, access such as Read, Write or Call). Use it to see who calls, reads or writes a tag, block, type or constant before changing it, and to find objects nothing refers to. target names ONE object (block, type, tag, constant or tag table; with kind=blockgroup a user group name or a path such as Motors/Conveyor); without target the whole PLC is read. kind is plc, block, type, tag, constant, tagtable or blockgroup. Without kind the name is auto-detected across block, type, tag, constant and tag table (blocks and types in every user group): one match is used, several are 409 ambiguous_target (details lists the kinds: repeat with kind=), none is 404 not_found; kind=blockgroup is never auto-detected. filter: AllObjects (default), ObjectsWithReferences, ObjectsWithoutReferences or UnusedObjects. UnusedObjects are CANDIDATES, not proof: OBs, objects reached only from outside the PLC (HMI, OPC UA, Modbus, other CPUs, external applications) and library entry points show as unreferenced, so recommend and let the human decide, never delete from this result. On a big project scope the read with target and kind: the whole-PLC read of a large project can take minutes. A target that does not offer cross-references, or a container read with no queryable owner, is 409 crossrefs_unavailable (it depends on the TIA/CPU version). Paging: limit (1..1000) and cursor page the sources. A page adds total and nextCursor: pass it back as cursor until nextCursor is null; cursor_stale: restart without cursor; invalid_cursor: pass it unchanged. Each page re-reads the whole PLC, so paging bounds the size of the response, not the time of the walk, and a later page can report less than an earlier one. summary and coverage describe the WHOLE result: check coverage on every page. coverage is {complete, owners, queried, unavailable, unavailableOwners, unavailableOwnersTruncated}: UnusedObjects, and any claim that nothing uses an object, hold only when coverage.complete is true on every page and every page was read; an omission marker or incomplete coverage on any page is NOT complete: claim nothing about unqueried objects. Requires a connected project. Maps to GET /plcs/{plc}/crossrefs?target=&kind=&filter=&limit=&cursor=. Read-only (class R). Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

cursor.description: the nextCursor of the previous page, passed back exactly as received; it is opaque, so never invent, build or edit one (omit it for the first page, and omit both limit and cursor for the whole list)

filter.description: which sources to list: AllObjects (default), ObjectsWithReferences, ObjectsWithoutReferences or UnusedObjects (candidates, not proof)

kind.description: what target names: plc, block, type, tag, constant, tagtable or blockgroup; omit to auto-detect across block, type, tag, constant and tagtable (blockgroup is never auto-detected)

limit.description: page size, an integer from 1 to 1000; pass it to read the list in pages (omit both limit and cursor for the whole list)

target.description: name of ONE object (block, type, tag, constant or tag table; with kind=blockgroup a user group name or a path such as Motors/Conveyor); omit or leave empty for the whole PLC
